mechanics.original_reminder: To consume, sacrifice another creature or exile a creature card from your graveyard.
mechanics.executable_reminder: Pay the cost "Choose {Subject}. Choose one of the following: [Sacrifice a creature you control other than the chosen creature] or [Exile a creature card from your graveyard]"

rule_text.name: 701.90a
rule_text.rule: Consume is a keyword action. To have a creature consume, sacrifice a creature other than the creature consuming, or exile a creature card from your graveyard.

rule_text.name: 701.90b
rule_text.rule: The creature that consumed may have linked abilities related to the cards it consumed.

rule_text.name: 701.90c
rule_text.rule: Consume a type is a variant of the consume action. To have a creature “consume a [type],” sacrifice a permanent of that type other than the creature consuming, or exile a card of that type from your graveyard.

rule_text.name: 701.90a
rule_text.rule: Consume is a keyword action. To have a creature consume, sacrifice a creature other than the creature consuming, or exile a creature card from your graveyard.

rule_text.name: 701.90b
rule_text.rule: The creature that consumed may have linked abilities related to the cards it consumed.

rule_text.name: 701.90c
rule_text.rule: Consume a type is a variant of the consume action. To have a creature “consume a [type],” sacrifice a permanent of that type other than the creature consuming, or exile a card of that type from your graveyard.
